scientific_limitations_and_integrity.computational_integrity: Exhaustive, exact and deterministic degree-two field counts in two polynomial bases; independent cube-root counting formulas; direct multinomial Hasse matrix check. Verifier source included.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: The 14 normalized coefficient-marked smooth order-six quartics over the prime field of seventeen elements, excluding the larger-symmetry member with parameter zero.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.independence: No independent mathematical audit or third-party validation performed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: Not all arithmetic twists or characteristics; geometric isomorphism criterion and the existence of maximal members were already present in cited literature. Existing large quartic databases may contain unpublished stronger tables.
